title: Utilization of firefighting resources.
bodyText: The state fire marshal, in consultation with the Hawaii emergency management agency, shall provide advice and counsel to the governor on the most practical utilization of the firefighting resources of the State.
bodyHtml: [§132-37]  Utilization of firefighting resources.  The state fire marshal, in consultation with the Hawaii emergency management agency, shall provide advice and counsel to the governor on the most practical utilization of the firefighting resources of the State. [L 2025, c 302, pt of §3]
